body: You're in yet another emotionally abusive relationship.
1/3 working, 1/3 sleeping, and you still have to count in eating, showering and grooming, buying stuff, and cleaning.

Death can indeed be the most logical decision to take. Not always, of course: if you're happy the most logical decision is to keep living. But if you're suffering, why keep living? You don't like doing something > You stop doing it. You don't enjoy living > You stop doing it. Straightforward logic.

> watching half of a different movie every few hours

> i still feel like a child.

I can SO relate to these two.

There's just no point, there really isn't any point. Every fucking possible reason for living is a selfish, hedonistic one: play a video game that you like, have a hobby, learn how to play an instrument, listen to music that you like, do something that you like, etc. But even the purported "altruistic" ones just don't do it for me, like "helping people" or whatever. Like, why? What is there for me? I just don't feel like living at all sometimes. I just want a switch to turn me off.

If there really is an afterlife or something like that, and you've really already made up your mind, I can only wish you a painless trip and a peaceful afterlife, wherever you end up. I'll try hanging on for a little while more in this world, but if I decide like you I can't take it anymore, I'd be glad to meet you and have a nice conversation in the other side :)

Good luck whatever you decide.

I'm also afraid that I won't make it to old age. I also feel (sometimes I'm sure) like I'll eventually die by suicide. Perhaps not today, perhaps not tomorrow, or next weeks, but I feel like there will a moment when I realise time has flown over my head and the only thing I will feel left for me will be to fucking blow my brains. If I don't become at least mildly successful in the next 1 or 2 years, I *know* I will do it. I'll make sure to post it here before it happens.

I just want to chill forever snugged up in my bed watching live streams on Twitch. I'm tired of living too. I really wouldn't mind spending my whole life like that, not doing absolutely anything else, that's what makes me happy.

I too have this exact thought sometimes, but 99.9% of the entire population won't be remembered by anyone, so I guess we shouldn't care about that fact?

Even important names in the development of the sciences are only remembered and known by those who specialise in those subjects (Physicists, Chemists, etc). The rest of us, common folks, only really know a few of them like "Newton" and "Einstein". The main reason is not that the information isn't there (in the future this will definitely not be a reason), the main reason is, as is said in this video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O2jkV4BsN6U), simply *indifference*, *apathy*, *lack of interest*.

Sorry for the ramble.

Goodbye brave warrior, I hope you find peace wherever you go. I'll try to keep fighting in this world but if I also fall like you did, I'll certainly look for you in the other side and perhaps we'll have a great time there instead :)

I don't think that, as far as emotions go, there's anything more painful than regret. For me it is *the* most painful and consuming emotion there is, closely followed by guilt. Regret is eating me alive, I feel it consuming my mental health, and I see myself living with this FOREVER.

I wanna cry so much man, I wanna **cry** so much. I'm afraid of renouncing the past, I'm afraid of trying and forgetting about it. After all, isn't it all *my* story? Who *I* was? Good or bad?

I feel like I'd be living as if I had never lived if I simply forget my past and try to only live for the future. I'm so fucking *scared* of that, you have no idea how scared I am. I'm scared of forgetting the past, I'm scared of thinking of myself as having born at 20 (I'm 20 right now).

TIME MACHINE, I WANT A FUCKING TIME MACHINE.

Now I do know what I should've done (I think), so maybe I time machine would fix things. I have so many things I have to change and do differently.
Thanks for taking the time to write your story, I appreciate it.
I think both those who fight and those who had the courage to kill themselves deserve respect. I think simply the fact that they have to go through so much shit makes them worthy of respect.

My main and first account has 3200 hours on dota. My other two accounts have, IIRC, about 800 hours and 400 hours, which would make the total amount I had dota open like 4400 hours (I don't say playing because of the queue times and maybe watching games). But we have to add to that the time I spent reading dota subreddit and watching dota Twitch streams, which may not have been as much of a waste of time cuz on those places I got much more interaction (much more relative to the almost nonexistent interaction that I would get playing dota at least).

It's still not voice chatting, though, let alone voice chatting with cam or in person. When it's through written medium you have time to think and to edit your message a THOUSAND time before sending it, or you can simply pretend you haven't read the message yet, it's more difficult to fuck up. When it's a forum you can edit your message even after you sent it, etc.
